meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 你提出改造 NanoClaw 时,Claude 会先反问确认需求,优先调用现成技能(如 /add-telegram、/manage-channels),没有对应技能时才改路由、容器配置或 CLAUDE.md,并告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 增加输入渠道(Telegram、Slack、邮件等)、修改触发规则或加入集成、改动路由时触发;它也会在你要求其他定制时接管并先提问确认。

say.text: 帮我加入 Telegram 作为输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个 agent group

say.text: 把 Gmail 集成进来,给某个 agent group 用
改一下这个 agent group 的人设和回复风格

howto.what_en: When you ask to change NanoClaw, Claude first asks clarifying questions, then prefers an existing skill (e.g. /add-telegram). If none fits, it edits routing, container config, or CLAUDE.md, then tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add input channels (Telegram, Slack, email, etc.), change trigger rules or add integrations, or modify routing; it asks questions before making changes.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: It asks which agent group to wire

say_en.text: Add the Gmail tool to one agent group
Change this agent group's persona and reply style
